I added a 0.25s sleep after each sandbox call in `tests/test_payments.py`, so the test now makes at most 4 calls per second, under the sandbox's limit of 5. The delay is a named constant, `SANDBOX_CALL_INTERVAL_S`, with a comment saying why it's there. The test makes four calls, so it takes about a second longer. I haven't run it.

One thing to watch: the delay only spaces out calls within this one test. If CI runs tests in parallel (e.g. pytest-xdist) and other tests also call the sandbox, together they can still go over 5 per second. If the flakes continue, the next steps are a shared throttle or retrying on 429 responses.

I also saved the rate limit to the project's EngramDB memory so future sessions will know about it.
